teams-violet.$description: Teams Violet — Primary CTA buttons, active nav underlines, badge backgrounds — the single saturated signal on an otherwise achromatic page. Vivid violet-purple stands apart from Microsoft blue (#0067b8) to brand Teams distinctly within the Microsoft ecosystem.

teams-midnight.$description: Teams Midnight — Hover and pressed states for Teams Violet buttons, nav link active text — darker violet that deepens without shifting hue.

teams-deep.$description: Teams Deep — Button pressed/focus states — intermediate violet between Teams Violet and Teams Midnight.

microsoft-blue.$description: Microsoft Blue — Link text, icon fills, navigation affordances — the legacy Microsoft hyperlink blue used on informational elements, never on CTA buttons.

ink-navy.$description: Ink Navy — Primary text, headings, body copy, icons — near-black with a distinct blue cast that avoids pure black harshness.

abyss-navy.$description: Abyss Navy — Darkest heading weight, button text on transparent dark-background variants.

steel.$description: Steel — Secondary body text, captions, placeholder text, icon color for inactive states.

graphite.$description: Graphite — Nav link text, body text at medium emphasis.

cloud.$description: Cloud — Page backgrounds, card surfaces, button text on dark.

frost.$description: Frost — Footer background, alternate section background.

lace.$description: Lace — Subtle lilac-tinted surface for decorative hero background areas.

ice-border.$description: Ice Border — Badge borders, light blue-tinted separator lines.

mist.$description: Mist — Subtle borders, dividers, input outlines in resting state.

near-white.$description: Near White — Card surface background — one step off pure white to reduce glare on elevated surfaces.

segoe-ui-variable-text.$description: The primary workhorse: all headings, body text, nav labels, buttons, badges. Microsoft's own variable font whose optical sizing axis auto-adjusts letterform construction at different sizes — tighter tracking at display scale (48px at −0.01em to −0.025em) is baked into the font's design intent, not added post hoc.

segoe-ui-variable-display.$description: Hero and section headings at large scale — the Display optical axis activates wider, more open letterforms than the Text axis at the same point size, making headlines feel more authoritative at 48px and above.

segoe-ui-variable-small.$description: Tight-tracked small labels and fine-print contexts.

segoe-ui.$description: System fallback used in footer, some nav utility links, and browser-rendered UI chrome. No tracking adjustments — falls back to OS default rendering.
